parts.content:
Metrics, the app's agreed definitions; place one with add_metric. Column dimensions can be filtered by name through parameters:
- capacity (source data, table turbines): Installed wind capacity, from the turbine table.
  measures: capacity_mw (Rated capacity in MW; format ,.1f), turbines (Number of turbines; format ,)
  dimensions: state (Two-letter state code), year (Year the project came online)
  parameters: since (First year included; integer, filters p_year >=)

1 table(s) in source 'data' (duckdb SQL):
turbines (6 rows)
  p_name VARCHAR {Roscoe:2, Alta:1, Fowler Ridge:1, Horse Hollow:1, Story:1}
  t_state VARCHAR {TX:3, CA:1, IA:1, IN:1}
  p_year INTEGER 1999..2015
  t_cap INTEGER 1000..3000 unique
